fields.h1: Build an Employee Referral Form That Tracks Every Bonus
fields.hero_description: Staff use an employee referral form to recommend someone for an open role. Emergent builds it with the tracker that decides who earns a bonus and when it pays.
fields.features_heading: What Happens After a Referral Comes In
fields.features_subheading: A PDF records the referral and stops there. Emergent's version checks it against your policy and keeps the bonus on a schedule.
fields.feature_1:
Every referral tied to a posted role

Lets the referrer pick from your list of open jobs instead of typing a title. Each referral carries the requisition ID, and the recruiter sees which pipeline it belongs to.
fields.feature_2:
The candidate confirms first

Emails the person being referred a link to say yes and upload a current resume. Nobody lands in your hiring pipeline without knowing, and the resume comes from its owner.
fields.feature_3:
Duplicates caught on submit

Matches the email and phone number against earlier referrals and current applicants. Credit stays with the earliest submission, and any later referrer gets a short, polite note.
fields.feature_4:
Your eligibility rules, applied

Reads the policy you describe: who cannot earn a bonus, which roles pay and how much. A referral from the hiring manager for their own team is marked not eligible on the record.
fields.feature_5:
Payout dates from the start date

Works out each bonus date once the hire starts, whether you pay once or in halves. Payroll sees the list ahead of time, and a payment drops if the hire leaves early.
fields.feature_6:
Code that moves with you

Exports the full codebase to your GitHub on paid plans. Your team can host the referral app on its own servers or connect it to the applicant tracking system you run today.
fields.why_description: Every referral, resume and payout date is a row in a database your company owns.

fields.usecase_heading: Four Teams That Hire Through Referrals
fields.tab_content_1:
The candidate says yes before a recruiter calls

Engineers refer the people they shipped with. At Lumen Labs, a backend engineer picks the open role and notes she worked with the candidate for 3 years. He gets an email to confirm interest and upload a resume. Only then is the referral sent to the recruiter.
fields.tab_content_2:
Payroll sees each $1,500 date from day one

Nursing referrals cost real money. Lakeview Health pays $3,000 for a referred ICU nurse, $1,500 after 6 months and $1,500 after 12. When the start date goes in, the referral record shows both payout dates for payroll. The second $1,500 is canceled if the nurse leaves before then.
fields.tab_content_3:
Two associates, one candidate, one bonus

Store associates know the same people. Two Globex Outfitters associates refer the same candidate, the first at 9:14 AM and the second the next morning. The app spots the shared email and phone number and keeps credit with the first submission. The second associate gets a note that the candidate is already referred.
fields.tab_content_4:
Which of 64 referrals earn a bonus this quarter

Referral bonuses are a budget line. Northwind Logistics' talent lead sees 64 referrals and 18 hires on one screen. Four of those hires were referred by their own hiring manager, which the policy excludes. The other 14 earn $1,500 each, and $21,000 is scheduled for payroll.

fields.howto_title: How to Create an Employee Referral Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps for HR teams: settle the policy first, then build a form that applies it and pays on time.
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Tie each referral to a posted role
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Ask how the two know each other
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Let the candidate confirm and upload
fields.howto_step_1_des: Decide who can refer, which roles pay a bonus, how much and when. SHRM's sample policy leaves out HR staff and managers with hiring authority over the candidate. Settle your own exclusions before launch, because the form will apply them to every referral.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Let the referrer choose from a list of open jobs. A requisition ID on each referral tells the recruiter where it belongs. It also lets you turn away referrals dated before the posting, a rule SHRM's sample policy uses.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Offer fixed choices: worked together, studied together, friend or family, met professionally. Add how long, plus one line on why the person would do the job well. A recruiter reads three years on the same team differently from a single meeting.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Send the candidate a short link to confirm interest and add a resume. People are never referred without knowing about it, and the resume arrives from the person it describes. Referrals that nobody confirms within a week can close on their own.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Compare each new candidate with past referrals and with anyone who has already applied. Keep credit with the earliest submission. Tell any later referrer the person is already in the pipeline without naming who got there first.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Schedule payouts from the start date
fields.howto_step_6_des: Once the hire starts, work out each payout date from your policy, whether that is one payment after 90 days or two halves over a year. Payroll gets the list ahead of each date, and payments stop if the hire leaves first.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Give each referrer a status for every person they put forward: received, interviewing, hired, payout scheduled. Employees can check progress without emailing HR, and interview feedback stays with the hiring team.

plan.angle: The top 10 is SHRM's sample form, three PDFs from a village, a nonprofit and a college, two template sellers, an MRA bonus slip and a Workstream policy page. Each is a slip that HR files by hand, and none says what happens after it. This page is the internal program form only: the fields that settle who gets credit (role, relationship, resume, the candidate's own confirmation), the eligibility rules that decide whether a bonus is owed, and the tracking HR needs to pay it on the right date. It leaves patient, student and customer referrals to the general referral form page.
